title: Printable sample space grids
subject: Mathematics
source: Seeded from mathematics/y9 lesson 71 (Printable sample space grids)
intro: Lesson 71: Sample space diagrams for two events. To understand how to use a sample space diagram to find probabilities of combined events

questions.q: From the grid, P(total is even)?
Two fair dice. Draw the product grid. Find P(product = 6), P(product is odd), P(product > 20).
questions.model: Product 6: (1, 6), (2, 3), (3, 2), (6, 1): 4 cells. Odd needs both odd: 3 × 3 = 9 cells. Over 20: 24, 25, 30, 30, 36, 24: 6 cells.

questions.q: Is the game 'player 1 wins if the total of two dice is 6, 7 or 8' fair? Explain.
questions.a: No: P = 16/36 = 4/9, less than 1/2, so player 2 is more likely to win

questions.q: Spinner A (1 to 3) and spinner B (1 to 4) are spun 120 times. How many times would you expect a total of 5?
Big question: which total is most likely?
questions.a: The total made by the most cells in the grid: for spinners A and B, 4 and 5 (3 cells each).
